name: rollback-targets
attack: a newer timestamp (TS_VERSION+7200) and snapshot v3 whose `targets.json` entry is v1 after targets v2 was accepted; the pair metadata/3.snapshot.json + metadata/1.targets.json
prior_state: client already accepted the 'valid' repository at the same clock
error_class: Rollback: the targets version in the new snapshot (v1) is lower than the trusted one (python-tuf refuses at the targets step with BadVersionNumberError; a client MAY equally refuse at the snapshot step, but must never accept)
